text: Develop and calibrate a sound economic priority model
description: Maintain an inspectable priority model that conserves graph value, distributes cost, discounts delayed returns, accounts for cost/value uncertainty, and uses aim surface as node mass in graph forces. The implemented model is a decision aid, not proof of economic value. Remaining work is calibration against authoritative observations from real deliveries: estimated versus actual duration, founder time, model/integration cost, external outcome, revenue, and prediction error. Do not auto-mutate human-set intrinsic value from activity counts or simulated credits. Revisit constants and uncertainty penalties only after enough comparable real runs exist.

status.comment: Core mechanics are implemented and verified: value flow, cost distribution, duration discounting, variance penalties, and flow-force distribution by aim surface. Real-world calibration remains blocked on completed external-value runs with authoritative economics.

reflection: Reconciled the broad stale aim against current code and graph evidence. surfaceMovementShares divides connection correction by squared endpoint radius, so larger aims are more inertial; the focused frontend suite passes 35 files / 177 tests. calculateAimValues already applies duration-based daily discounting plus proportional cost/value variance penalties; its focused 3-test suite passes. The remaining economic work is empirical calibration from paid or externally evaluated runs, not another speculative formula.
